structure.title: Session structure
structure.help: All blocks are optional. Complete only those that apply to the workout.

prescriptions.title: Group prescriptions
prescriptions.help: Select at least one microcycle to assign the session and define its load. If a group has multiple microcycles on the chosen date, explicitly select those that apply.
prescriptions.noMicrocycles: This group has no available microcycles.
prescriptions.microcycleUnavailable: No microcycle is available for group {group} on the selected date.
prescriptions.microcycleAmbiguous: Multiple microcycles overlap for group {group} on the selected date. Correct the periods before saving.

vertical.title: Vertical prescription
vertical.help: The objective and block are optional and independent. Neither is inferred from distance or session type.
vertical.completeHelp: The block represents all quantified session D+. The total is derived from repetitions.
vertical.partialHelp: The block subtotal is already included in total session D+; do not add it again.
vertical.wholeHelp: Total D+ is optional. Leave blank if unknown; 0 means confirmed zero.
vertical.unsupported: Unsupported vertical version. The block is preserved without editing; its objective and D+ cannot be changed here.
vertical.corrupt: Invalid vertical data. Preserved without reinterpretation; the block, objective and D+ cannot be edited.
vertical.opaqueHistory: An unsupported or corrupt vertical block cannot be modified.
vertical.historicalTrack: This block retains historical track provenance. Without verifiable authorization, an edit retaining it cannot be saved. Explicitly remove it or cancel.
vertical.trackUnavailable: Track metric adoption is unavailable until its authorization can be verified. Manual prescriptions do not require a track.
vertical.executionHelp: Use duration, structure and group instructions for RPE, Talk Test, recovery and descent safety.
vertical.invalidBlock: Check repetitions and meters: use valid integers within the supported range.
vertical.invalidTotal: Check total D+: it must equal the complete block or not be below the known partial subtotal.
vertical.templateConflict: The template may change vertical decisions. Apply the rest while preserving affected prescriptions, or cancel.
vertical.historicalRemovalPending: The historical block will be removed only on save. It will not be converted to manual data.
